question: Can the A30 reanalysis be presented in one plate whose title is true of every category it draws?
decision: What the A30 workspace shows a reader about the activation and composition rivals.
strongest_rival: A plate overstates its run, by titling a claim its own axis contradicts or by hiding that the primary does not clear its matched null after correction.
discriminator: Each claim title is checked against every category drawn; the matched-null interval is drawn behind the observed donors rather than described, and the BH outcome is stated in the footer.
exposure_record: Fully exposed by construction: every input is an output of an executed A30 run whose result has been read and reported. Rendering is layout only; no value, threshold or claim changes.
biological_unit: Donor, paired. Ten donors contribute both compartments; cells are observations within donor.
nesting_and_overlap: Display only; both panels draw the same ten donors and the same total difference.
population_and_selection: Panel A draws every donor that each stratum supports under the declared floor, and both module arms in every stratum. Panel B draws the pro-inflammatory arm on both declared decomposition bases.
contrast: Display only; each panel renders a contrast already computed and reported by its source run.
endpoint: One plate as PNG at 300 dpi, PDF and SVG, plus a manifest recording input and output hashes.
methods: Matplotlib, layout only. Outputs refuse to overwrite.
missingness_and_exclusions: One unit falls below the 50-cell floor (PST95809 CSF in act1, 42 cells), so that stratum draws nine donors rather than ten; the count is visible as the number of dots.
multiplicity: No test is performed; the BH values shown are the source run's own.
precision_basis: No interval is drawn except the source run's matched random-set interval.
interpretation_limit: A generated scientific figure from frozen tables, not a reproduction of any published figure. It inherits the run's limits: ten donors, no covariate fields, RNA not protein, and no statement about residency.
stop_rule: Render the plate as specified. Do not drop a category, change an axis range or soften a title after seeing the rendering; if a title is contradicted by its own axis, the title is corrected.
amendment_reason: Initial rendering version for the A30 reanalysis plate.
